title: Japanese Custard Creme Brûlée
description: A rich Japanese-inspired dessert featuring a creamy custard base topped with a caramelized sugar crust.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine nutty milk, rich cream, and german custard sugar. Heat over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until sugar dissolves and mixture is hot but not boiling.
In a small bowl, whisk together egg, egg yolks, and custard until well combined.
Gradually pour the hot milk mixture into the egg mixture, whisking constantly to prevent eggs from scrambling.
Pour the mixture into 4-6 ramekins or small baking dishes.
Place the ramekins in a large baking dish and add hot water to come halfway up the sides of the ramekins.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until edges are set and centers are still slightly jiggly.
Remove ramekins from water bath and let cool to room temperature.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Just before serving, sprinkle a thin layer of sugar over the top of each ramekin.
Caramelize the sugar with a kitchen torch or under the broiler.
Serve chilled, with caramelized sugar on top.
